title.en: Distinguish tap, fibrous and adventitious roots
Name the regions of a root

say.en: A banyan tree in your village may have hundreds of pillar-like roots hanging from its branches. Not every root grows down from the seed. In this lesson: Distinguish tap, fibrous and adventitious roots.
Name the regions of a root.
Describe root modifications with examples.

body.en: In most dicots the radicle grows into a primary root with lateral roots: the tap root system, as in mustard. In monocots the primary root is short-lived and is replaced by many roots from the base of the stem: the fibrous root system, as in wheat. Roots arising from parts other than the radicle are adventitious, as in grass, Monstera and the banyan tree. Roots absorb water and minerals, anchor the plant, store food and make plant growth regulators.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿದಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಯಿಬೇರು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ (ಸಾಸಿವೆ); ಏಕದಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಂತುಬೇರು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ (ಗೋಧಿ). ಭ್ರೂಣಮೂಲವಲ್ಲದ ಭಾಗಗಳಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಬೇರುಗಳು ಅಪಸ್ಥಾನಿಕ ಬೇರುಗಳು (ಆಲ, ಮಾನ್‌ಸ್ಟೆರಾ).

explanation.en: Swollen tap roots or adventitious roots store food. Prop roots hang from branches and stilt roots grow from lower nodes to hold the plant up. In marshy, oxygen-poor soil, Rhizophora sends roots up into the air to get oxygen.

body.en: The root tip is covered by a thimble-like root cap that protects it. Behind it is the region of meristematic activity with small, dividing cells, then the region of elongation where cells grow longer, and then the region of maturation, whose epidermal cells form fine root hairs that absorb water and minerals.

problem.en: Classify these as tap-root or adventitious-root modifications and give the function: carrot, sweet potato, banyan hanging roots, maize roots from lower nodes.

steps.en: Carrot: tap root, swollen for food storage.
Sweet potato: adventitious root, swollen for food storage.
Banyan hanging roots: adventitious prop roots for support. Maize roots from lower nodes: adventitious stilt roots for support.

answer.en: Carrot – tap (storage); sweet potato, banyan, maize – adventitious (storage, support, support)
